title: JOINT EMPIRICAL RECONSTRUCTIBILITY & RETENTION COURT
jurisdiction: physical empirical retention, reconstructibility, replay identity, V550/V550J co-execution; no V551/V552 redesign

disposition.summary: Retain a content-addressed lossless source snapshot or source-equivalent projection plus exact deterministic replay authority; make normalized respondent substrate a regenerable cache; persist compiled direct-DAG terminal serving authority independently.
disposition.deletion_gate: Current normalized respondent substrate may be deleted only after immutable source replay is mandatory, hash-bound, and certified to regenerate the expected logical substrate hash.

canonical_binding_failures: Extra dataframe columns physically survive canonicalization but are excluded from logical content hash.
No generic V550 structural-position/determinicity coordinate family is first-class in the declared logical columns.
No dedicated is_not_asked logical field exists; exact structural not-asked requires respondent-universe plus routing/applicability authority.
The helper cache signature does not require immutable raw/source snapshot content identity.

information_theoretic_requirements.principle: Exact future same-respondent conjunctions require respondent-level joint incidence or an information-equivalent source representation from which that incidence can be deterministically regenerated.
must_preserve: all coordinates inside the governed future-authority frontier
source provenance sufficient for replay identity
information_theoretic_requirements.aggregate_closure_condition: Aggregate closure is sufficient only if complete enough to be information-equivalent to every future-authorizable joint incidence; finite present marginals/joints are insufficient.

A.name: normalized_respondent_grain_empirical_substrate
A.key_strength: preserves current same-respondent incidence, weights, typed states, and V550J union
A.key_failure: derived/privacy-heavy; omitted raw coordinates and incidental extras cannot support arbitrary future authorization

B.name: immutable_source_snapshot_plus_exact_deterministic_extraction_compiler
B.key_strength: retains joint information once and supports future predicates within retained source frontier
B.key_failure: unsafe if source is only a mutable pointer or compiler/semantic/routing/weight authorities are not pinned

C.name: bounded_aggregate_closure
C.key_failure: cannot reconstruct unseen dependence, future predicates, or new same-respondent V550J joints

D.name: hybrid
components: persistent V557/V558-governed compiled direct-DAG terminal serving artifacts

durable_source_capsule: raw response codes and governed typed states
routing/applicability data sufficient to reconstruct not-asked
recommended_minimum_physical_retention.projection_rule: A canonical source projection may replace literal raw bytes only if discarded coordinates are outside an explicitly governed future-authority frontier and information equivalence is proved.

replay_hash_identity_requirements: source capsule content hash and format/schema identity
V550 position/determinicity authority hash when derived
direct-DAG emitted artifact identity and compiler authority

v550j_coexecution.future_configuration_rule: Newly authorized V550J configurations are reconstructible only when all required variables remain inside the retained source-coordinate frontier.
v550j_coexecution.aggregate_warning: Once respondent incidence is discarded in favor of incomplete aggregates, a new same-respondent joint cannot be recovered.

safe_to_recompute_after_certified_source: base/joint selection roles and configuration annotations
V550 position coordinates if deterministically derived under pinned authority
must_persist_for_runtime_even_if_recompi: V557/V558-governed compiled direct-DAG terminal serving authority
unresolved_retention_policy_questions: Exact source-coordinate frontier permitted for future authorization.
Where immutable source snapshot/projection content hash becomes mandatory.
Whether literal source bytes or a canonical lossless projection is the retained authority.
Exact not-asked/routing/applicability authority across sources and waves.
Which position coordinates are raw source facts versus deterministic V550 derivations and how derivation authority is hash-bound.
Weight-variable and transformation authority by source/wave.
Privacy/access controls and lifetime for respondent-grain source and cache.
Compiler/dependency hermeticity required for deterministic replay.
Automated deletion gate for shared respondent cache.
Whether future authority may expand beyond today's retained source frontier.
final_ruling: Do not retain the broad determinicity suite as canonical empirical memory; do not replace respondent incidence with finite present aggregate closure; retain a lossless content-addressed source authority plus pinned deterministic replay authority, persist terminal direct-DAG serving artifacts, and treat the normalized shared respondent substrate as auditable regenerable cache after replay certification.
